data.translation: Warte doch eben zwei Minuten, damit ich vom Schauplatz wegmache;

rationale: First Detransitive Infectum box and first Detransitive sense; self-directed escape, source m-.

summary: New sense 1: (Detrans.) (mit m-) sich retten, entkommen
rationale: mi- form with a self-moving subject and source mi ḥolo, contrasting with active retten; one attestation.

summary: The protective Moryo mnaǧe formula is active Infectum with implicit protected people, already quoted. It does not by itself establish a new idiom or sense.
The mi- form minaganno has a self-moving subject, no externally expressed rescuer, and a m-source. It supports the Detransitive lexical counterpart to retten rather than a forced agentless reading.
The source spells g where the entry uses ǧ. Preserve minaganno as supplied; no Detransitive Preterit base is reconstructed from this single Infectum token.
Confirm minaganno as the local Detransitive form of nǧy, including g/ǧ and the weak final consonant, from recording/paradigm evidence.
